# SF-F2: When a state names a model as proof that a threshold has been crossed, or ties a risk to a model's origin, how does that become checkable?

Area F · As of clef 7924 Berichte · Luna 7924 Berichte · d3-ultra 4771 Berichte · JEV 5667 Berichte · amos 7924 Berichte · drex 6984 Berichte · SubQ 7924 Berichte

## Subquestions

- [SF-F2-T01](../../fragen/SF-F2/T01/): When a ministry names a model as proof that a threshold has been crossed, does the ministry publish the tests, the model version and what it measured, and does the lab publish that version's cyber evaluation in the ministry's language too? And which result would make the ministry withdraw its claim?
- [SF-F2-T02](../../fragen/SF-F2/T02/): When a state names foreign models as signs of a new stage, does that rest on its own measurements that it could publish as others publish theirs? And have labs run comparable assessments of foreign models and chosen not to publish them? Asked about Minister Chen Yixin's naming of Claude Mythos and GPT-5.5-Cyber as signs of the “AI versus AI” stage in cyber offence and defence, after the US assessment body CAISI had published measurements of GLM-5.3 (17 September 2026) and, with the UK AI Security Institute, of Kimi K3 (July 2026), and about assessments by OpenAI and Anthropic of DeepSeek, GLM, Qwen or Kimi models.
- [SF-F2-T03](../../fragen/SF-F2/T03/): A minister describes risks from espionage and data leakage, for example through open-source AI agent tools, and from an imbalance in technological development that monopolies and technology restrictions aggravate. What published evidence would tie these risks to a model's capability rather than its origin?

## Reports by share of levels 4–7

Levels 4–7 / 3–7 = probability each model gives to these levels (3 = useful background or context, 4 = contains some facts that could be cited as evidence … 7 = directly and substantially answers the question). Listed: reports where clef or Luna give levels 3–7 more than 50 %. Sorted by the higher of clef and Luna for levels 4–7. Further models (JEV, amos, d3 …) rated part of the reports; the others show “not yet rated”. The full distribution over the 8 levels is in the data file.
